name: JSON Path Explorer
blurb: walk a large JSON and copy the access path of a field
intro: Walks every node of a JSON document and lists each field's access path in the style you code in (JavaScript, JSONPath, jq, Python or JSON Pointer), filtered by key or value. Type a path in any style to read the value there; with wildcards on, array indices collapse to [*] so a large list reads as its shape.

inputs.label: Read the value at
inputs.placeholder: a path in any style, e.g. $.orders[*].id

examples.title: Where is the tracking number, in JavaScript?
The shape of an order list as JSONPath

usage: Give json as text, an optional filter (a key or value fragment, case-insensitive), style (js, jsonpath, jq, python, pointer), rootVar for js/python, an optional pick path in any style ([*] takes every item), and booleans wildcard (collapse indices) and leaves (leaves only). Returns a table of paths with type and value preview, the path list as text, node count and depth, and the value at the pick path as JSON. Invalid JSON returns the line and column of the error.
sources: RFC 9535 JSONPath: Query Expressions for JSON (normalized paths)
